summary: BIOXIC round 5 — anti-theft (signed audio) + round-4 fixes verification. Backend: 32/32 pytest pass (24 existing + 8 new signed-audio tests). Signed URL protection works end-to-end: GET /api/files/<audio>.wav without sig => 403; with /api/media/sign => 200/206; expired exp => 403; tampered sig => 403; covers remain public without sig; /api/media/sign rejects non-/api/files URLs with 400 and passes-through covers unchanged. Protection.jsx verified: contextmenu, F12, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+S all have defaultPrevented=true; normal 'a' key is NOT prevented (site remains usable). Mobile 390px: pb-live pill is now VISIBLE (box y=785, w=88 — iteration_4 bug FIXED). Audio element src on live playback carries ?exp=&sig= — signing flow works in browser. Piese seek fix verified: clicking the single track card now enters track mode (mode==='track'), player-progress gets 'seekable' class, player-live-badge hidden, track-playing-badge-* appears, audio.src is re-fetched signed; onSeek has Math.min/max clamp (0-1). ONE regression NOT fixed: mobile 390px still has 22px horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth=412 vs innerWidth=390). body has overflow-x:hidden but inner content width is 412. Main offenders: queue-item-* div (left=16, right=412, width=396) in Live/Playlist column; tabs row (right=404); tab-despre reaches right=399. The queue-row needs min-w-0/overflow-hidden on its text children or the whole queue container to compress on 390px.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile 390px horizontal overflow 22px persists (scrollWidth=412 vs innerWidth=390). Primary offender: [data-testid^=queue-item-] (right=412), secondary: tabs row (right=404) and [data-testid=tab-despre] (right=399). body has overflow-x:hidden masking the scroll, but scrollWidth test still fails per spec acceptance criterion.

issues: Queue rows and tabs row still slightly wider than viewport — add min-w-0 to queue-row text content and consider making tabs row scroll internally rather than extend.

action_items: Fix remaining 22px mobile horizontal overflow at 390px: add min-w-0 (or overflow-hidden + truncate) to the queue-row inner text container (the artist/title block), and tighten padding of queue-row on <=390px. Also ensure the tabs row either wraps or scrolls internally within the viewport. Current body overflow-x:hidden hides it visually but the DOM test (documentElement.scrollWidth===innerWidth) still fails per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sign_file_url truncates HMAC-SHA256 to 32 hex chars (128 bits) — acceptable but note it; keep secret rotation in mind.
RadioContext loadSrc requests /api/media/sign on every track switch — fine, but consider caching the signed url for the TTL window to reduce round-trips.
Protection.jsx is disuasive only (as code comment acknowledges) — real protection is the signed URLs; good layered approach.
PlayerBar.jsx onSeek has correct clamp 0..1 via Math.min/Math.max.
Piese.jsx:20 track card click uses isCurrent && mode==='track' ? toggle() : playTrack — correctly enters track mode on first click, confirmed with 1 track in catalog.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (anti-theft, protection, LIVE pill, seek entry all OK; mobile overflow still 22px)

Protection.jsx validated via synthetic KeyboardEvent/MouseEvent dispatch and defaultPrevented. Mobile pb-live now visible (iter_4 fix OK). Seek entry on single-track catalog now works (click card -> track mode). Remaining issue: scrollWidth>innerWidth by 22px on 390px due to queue-item width 396 and tabs row 388; body overflow-x hidden hides scroll but acceptance test still fails. rca of the issue: Mobile overflow at 390px: queue-row (left=16, right=412, width=396) exceeds inner viewport. Children likely include non-min-width-0 flex items (artist name + play count) that force the row to its intrinsic width. Fix: on <=480px, add min-w-0 + truncate to the inner text block of queue-row, reduce horizontal padding from px-4 to px-3, or set the queue container to overflow-hidden with inner flex items having min-w-0.
